Steeplejack Charles Miller
(1882–1910),
[
1
]
nicknamed the
Human Fly
, was an American man famous for
climbing buildings
. He began climbing in 1900, and earned a living from his stunts. Miller did not use any climbing equipment. He died after falling sixty feet from the fourth floor of the Hamburger building in
Los Angeles
in full view of hundreds of spectators, who transported his unconscious body to the hospital, where he later succumbed to his injuries.
